title: Autovacuum Tuning, Table Bloat, and Freeze Wraparound
realWorldScenario: A production PostgreSQL database with high write volume triggers a critical monitoring alert: `database age is 1,850,000,000 transactions; danger of shutdown in 150 million transactions`. Autovacuum appears unable to keep up.
questionStatement: Explain the PostgreSQL Transaction ID (XID) wraparound hazard and the purpose of `VACUUM FREEZE`. What causes autovacuum worker starvation, and how do you tune autovacuum cost limits, scale factors, and workers to prevent database emergency shutdown?
expectedConcepts: 32-bit XID space and modulo 2^31 visibility horizon
Anti-wraparound autovacuum and emergency database shutdown
hints: Why does 32-bit integer arithmetic wrap around at 2^31 in circular comparisons?
What happens to a tuple when its xmin is replaced with FrozenTransactionId?
Check autovacuum cost delay: workers sleep when accumulated I/O points reach cost limit.
